title: A build reads less, types less and waits less, and its words come from small structured page tasks applied with content.replace
steps: S1: plan.add of one appended row, of a tone on a row with no image, of an image then its tone, of an image on a row that has one, of a whole plan.
S2: compactSource of a website source with 2 crawled pages, 449 crawled pictures and a cursor; one page whole; a page out of range.

S3: copyPagesOf over three pages sharing a phone and a copyright; unsourcedFacts and checkBlock on grounded, ungrounded, too long, sample and interface words; a run with a model that fails one page twice.
S4: applyCopy over a 25-pair page with one pair the job refuses and a shared pack; a refusal naming no pair.
S5: runDemoQa with five nav pages that finish in reverse order; the baseline of a page with a heading, a text, a form text and two buttons.
expect: S1: 2 rows and 1 appended; 'row 0 has no image to tone'; tone accepted; 'row 0 has its image'; 'not plan'.
S2: no cursor, media {count:449}, page leads of 400 characters; the whole page answers; BAD_PAGE.
S3: the shared words split from the pages; (084) 555-0110, an e-mail and $56 unsourced; the failing page asked twice and listed as an issue.
S4: calls of 20, 19, 5 then 1 (shared from /); 24 placed, the refused pair under notPlaced; each pair tried alone after an unnamed refusal.
S5: home read alone, three at once after, pages and visited in page order; pageBlocks with heading, text and button, no form text, no nav button.
evidence: Local round 33 (26/10/2026, WordPress): 133 steps, 18 min of generation (208K output tokens), sources read of 518K characters, plan.save sent twice whole (65K), 5 checks × 145 s read one page after another.

tests: plan.add appends rows, gives images to rows that had none and tones to saved images, never the whole plan again
a crawled source is read as its index of pages, and one page whole when asked
copy.start runs the copy tasks once, copy.status says each page, copy.read answers the packs
words on most pages are shared (header, footer); the rest belong to their page
a run asks a brief, then every page and the shared words in parallel, and a page that fails twice is an issue
pairs go twenty a call; a refused pair is set aside by its index and the rest sent again
runDemoQa reads home alone, then the rest a few at once, and keeps page order whatever finishes first
the baseline keeps each page's words in order, headings and buttons marked, forms and nav left out
